class Grosser(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self,token,name,path):
        super().__init__(token)
        self.nam = name
        self.gouphins = path
        
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<typect|Grosser>"
        
class OnfexKoche(ASTNode):
    def __init__(self,token,name,path,parsed):
        super().__init__(token)
        self.nam = name
        self.gouphins = path
        self.prosins = parsed
        
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<typect|OnfexKoche>"
